acceptance_scope: Matched console gameplay and visual acceptance, with SD report and installed-file verification
verification_limits: Console visual/gameplay observations establish these checks; they are not instrumented frame-time or physical peak-memory measurements.
The post-restart report is a single snapshot; starts=1 and cleanup_callbacks=0 do not retain the preceding kill/reload session or prove its duration.
USB keyboard delivery remains untested: keyboard_presses=0.
Live pickup enumeration remains untested: pickups=0; object results reached the 128-handle probe cap.
The probe checks pointer availability; it does not test arbitrary global indices, entity offsets or memory writes.
Alpha blending and timed texture expiry were not separately confirmed in this console test.
Full eight-resident saturation, custom-limit overrides and extended soak remain separate tests.
Caller/runtime self-tests were not invoked in the supplied bridge report.
